question_cn: 国王印度局形成了白链e4-d5（链头d5指向黑方后翼）和黑链e5-d6（链头e5指向白方王翼）的对称双兵链。双方各自的正确进攻方向是？
question_en: In the King's Indian, White has a chain e4-d5 pointing toward Black's queenside, while Black's e5-d6 chain points toward White's kingside. Where should each side attack?

options.text_cn: 白方王翼进攻（f4-g4），黑方后翼进攻（c5-b5）
options.text_en: White attacks on the kingside with f4-g4; Black attacks on the queenside with ...c5-b5.

options.text_cn: 双方都应在中心兑换，打开局面
options.text_en: Both sides should exchange in the center to open the position.

options.text_cn: 白方后翼进攻（b4-b5），黑方王翼进攻（f5-f4）
options.text_en: White attacks on the queenside with b4-b5; Black attacks on the kingside with ...f5-f4.

options.text_cn: 谁的兵链更长谁先进攻，另一方等待
options.text_en: The side with the longer chain should attack first while the other waits.

explanation_cn: 双兵链对攻时，每方沿本方链头所指方向进攻：白链头d5指向黑方后翼（c6/b7方向），白方应在后翼发力（b4-b5突破）；黑链头e5指向白方王翼（f4/g3方向），黑方应在王翼总攻（f5-f4推进）。这形成「双翼竞速」——两侧同时进攻，谁先突破对方王的阵地谁就获胜。
explanation_en: With opposing pawn chains, each side attacks in the direction of its own chain head. White's d5 chain head points toward Black's queenside, so b4-b5 is a natural break. Black's e5 chain head points toward White's kingside, so ...f5-f4 is logical. This creates a race on opposite wings; the side that breaks through to the enemy king first may prevail.
